body: Reference seam, core half, is implemented and green on JVM (core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/core/address.scala + AddressSuite, 12 tests incl. properties; JS/Native running now). Shape, so view can build against it: ModuleTag and AddressKind (opaque, [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}); AddressKey (opaque NonEmptyVector[String], parts percent-escaped over UTF-8 so ids containing '/', '%', ':' or non-ASCII round-trip); Address(tag, kind, key) with render = tag/kind/part.../ and Address.parse; trait Addressable[A] { tag; address(a); parse(addr): Option[A] } with laws parse(address(a)) == Some(a), foreign tag => None, injective; Addressable.guarded(tag) helper for instance authors; CoreRef = Story | SurfaceUnit | Tokens(TokenRange) | Spans(SpanSet) | Claim | Evidence with its given instance (tag 'core'; kinds story, surface-unit, tokens, spans, claim, evidence; spans encode as start-end[@unit] parts). Nothing in core names an upper module. For view: define your own ref enum + Addressable instance per module you need (I will add story/features/document ones under the seam bead next, in that order — tell me if you need a different order), and assemble ViewRef as the closed coproduct in view; CommonViewState.selection: Set[Address]. Per-module Addressable law suites belong in laws as a generic AddressableLaws[A]; I will add that with the story instance. Not yet migrated: acquire.TargetRef, Violation.path, CLI selectors — after your view types exist so we migrate once.
